PROJECTS
Working Capital Optimisation

Budget and Forecasting Support

TECHNICAL SKILLS
• Excel: Advanced formulas, pivot tables, VBA macros, Power Query
• Data visualisation: Tableau, Power BI

• Database: SQL, Tally ERP

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS
• Financial reporting and statutory compliance
• Variance analysis and root cause identification

• Data-driven decision support

COURSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
